query.query: MATCH (s:Neuron)-[e:ConnectsTo]->(t:Neuron) WHERE s.type IN ['HSE','HSN','HSS','DNp15'] AND t.type IN ['HSE','HSN','HSS','DNp15'] RETURN s.bodyId AS source_id,t.bodyId AS target_id,s.type AS source_type,t.type AS target_type,e.weight AS structural_count ORDER BY s.bodyId,t.bodyId

neurotransmitter_provenance.query: MATCH (n:Neuron) WHERE n.bodyId IN [10015,10016,10023,10034,10181,10419,11215,12069] RETURN n.bodyId AS body_id,n.type AS type,n.somaSide AS side,n.predictedNt AS predicted_nt,n.predictedNtConfidence AS prediction_confidence,n.celltypePredictedNt AS type_predicted_nt,n.celltypePredictedNtConfidence AS type_prediction_confidence,n.consensusNt AS consensus_nt ORDER BY n.bodyId
limitations: Snapshot of public annotations, not immutable physiological measurements.
Prediction confidence is not release probability or sign confidence.
Consensus and type agreement do not establish exact receptor subtype, compartment, delay or unitary chemical effect.

candidate_edges.sign_limitation: Source cholinergic phenotype supports a putative excitatory sign, not a measured unitary effect or an identified transform from signed proxy state to chemical release and postsynaptic response.
candidate_edges.timing_evidence: No isolated chemical latency/kernel located for these pinned identities; motion response and calcium kinetics do not identify chemical-edge delay.
candidate_edges.magnitude_evidence: No compatible per-edge physiological magnitude located. Counts, NT confidence and dye intensity are not efficacy.
candidate_edges.limitation: Chemical structure and putative sign are supported; isolated recurrence in the existing proxy coordinate is not. Electrical coupling and other partners remain unresolved context.

primary_evidence.locator: Abstract and Results; whole-cell identified HSN/HSE/HSS recordings
primary_evidence.supports: Drosophila HS direction-selective graded responses to ipsilateral horizontal motion.
primary_evidence.limitations: Sensory response is not a paired recording of the seven candidate contacts; exact proxy tuning, magnitude and delay are not imported.

primary_evidence.locator: Phase24 committed evidence, Fig.2J DNHS1 identification; primary indexed text and 2025 paper reference32
primary_evidence.access: PMC full-text browser challenge in this audit; not used to establish any new edge-specific sign/gain.
primary_evidence.supports: HS/DNHS1 association and visual descending response context.
primary_evidence.limitations: Dye coupling is not isolated chemical efficacy or exact MaleCNS body-ID equivalence.

primary_evidence.publication_version: 2023 original preprint full text verified; 2024 eLife reviewed-preprint v1 identified, publisher page challenged.
primary_evidence.locator: Using neurotransmitter predictions to assign functional signs; EASI-FISH; Fig.5 threshold
primary_evidence.supports: HS/VS cholinergic predictions, regional ChAT corroboration and qualified expectation of excitatory outputs.
primary_evidence.limitations: Regional FISH is not exact-body ground truth; receptor/contact sign not measured; Fig.5 displays connections at least10 synapses, unlike these 1-4-count edges; electrical effects excluded by EM.

primary_evidence.locator: HSS glutamatergic candidate and Discussion on ectopic dvGlut driver labeling
primary_evidence.supports: Historical tentative HSS glutamatergic driver labeling with explicit uncertainty.
primary_evidence.limitations: Driver label is not transmitter release or postsynaptic sign. Do not override current predictions with a definitive inhibitory label or erase this caveat.

primary_evidence.locator: Loss of gap junctions; Fig.7 dye-coupling results and Discussion
primary_evidence.supports: HS-HS and HS-descending electrical context, including HSN-DNp15/DNHS1; perturbation changes HS passive/response properties.
primary_evidence.limitations: Dye intensity is a coupling proxy, not conductance; chemical/electrical contributions and the seven selected chemical interactions are not isolated; no exact MaleCNS junction identities/strengths imported.

primary_evidence.locator: Fig.1; central LPT recurrent networks; Electron microscopy datasets; Rdl manipulations
primary_evidence.supports: DNp15/DNHS1 terminology, HS motion response, broader inhibitory recurrent networks and chemical/electrical context.
primary_evidence.limitations: GABAergic LPTCrn results do not assign signs to HS-HS or DNp15-HSS contacts; brain datasets are FAFB/FlyWire/Hemibrain, not these exact MaleCNS contacts. EM does not resolve gap junctions.

primary_evidence.supports: MaleCNS neurotransmitter labels are prediction-pipeline annotations.
primary_evidence.limitations: No target receptor, edge gain, release probability or recurrent physiological kernel inferred.

electrical_context.limitation: Cannot import perturbation-induced network dynamics as a kernel for one chemical contact. This audit does not prove that all partial chemical models require a calibrated electrical model.

feedback_gate.reason: Structural return direction and transmitter annotation do not identify feedback law, chemical contribution, compartment or isolation from surrounding circuitry.

assumption_assessment.choice: Existing signed Phase25 source proxy as presynaptic chemical activity
Chemical delay, normalization and recurrent transfer magnitude

stage_a.decisive_gap: An effective recurrent chemical operator on the frozen signed proxy coordinate is not identified; source transmitter inference is not that operator.
reasoning: Putative excitatory signs are supported and not relabeled UNKNOWN merely because they are inferred.
No edge-specific recurrent transformation or isolated chemical timing/functional role was located. The signed source proxy is not biological transmitter release or membrane voltage.
Unknown gain alone would not prohibit an explicit exploratory scale; the blocker is the unresolved chemical-versus-electrical interaction and proxy-to-synaptic-effect semantics, especially feedback.
A mathematically stable positive recurrence could be invented, but would answer a new assumption-only toy-system question, not resolve this evidence-gated network extension.
Electrical context is material, but indispensability for every possible isolated model is not demonstrated; therefore do not choose the stronger electrical-required gate.

allowed_claims: All13 induced chemical routes revalidated from committed male-cns:v1.0 authority.
Source transmitter evidence supports qualified excitatory-sign inference.
Phase25 remains the current validated neural-only feedforward boundary.
Non-identifiability of the proposed extension is an evidence-gate outcome, not a simulation failure.
forbidden_claims: Proven absence of chemical recurrence or functional feedback in biology
audit.next_bounded_action: Audit public edge-resolved or chemical-isolating HS-HS physiological evidence for one verified reciprocal pair, 10015/10016 at neuron-type level, to define a chemical observation/transfer operator distinct from electrical coupling; no simulation or author contact.
limitations: Bounded public search, not proof that missing physiological evidence does not exist.
Neither source count nor transmitter annotation identifies a physiological gain.
No v1 or Phase25 authority/result/production code changes.
